'''Punchimp''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Rockfu]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Grabs and throws whatever can be found before fleeing from the subsequent mess. Punchimp's daily goal is to make at least one Tatari cry."

Punchimp is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, brown chimpanzee with a light brown head and underbelly, and an orange mask-like marking around its eyes. It has yellow pupils and black sclera. Its tail points straight up, and its inner ears are white.

Punchimp's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces brown with blue, and white with orange.

== Evolution Trial ==
Punchimp's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Rockfu]] you need to complete the following task:
* Obtain another Punchimp x1

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Gentle, kind, and harmless. Sometimes serves as a guest performer at mountain tourist spots."
* Before the August 5 2025 update, Punchimp's name was Capuhit.
